description: This file declares functions related to handling value change events in the rbus system, including adding, removing property nodes and closing handles.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_AddPropertyNode
methods.description: Adds a property node to the rbus handle for monitoring value changes.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_RemovePropertyNode
methods.description: Removes a property node from the rbus handle.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the rbus handle to release resources.
